nodes.summary: There is a real number $C > 0$ such that for every integer $N \ge 1$, every set $A \subseteq \mathbb{Z}/N\mathbb{Z}$ with $|A| \ge C\sqrt{N}$ has a nonempty subset $S \subseteq A$ whose elements sum to $0$ in $\mathbb{Z}/N\mathbb{Z}$.
nodes.title: Zero subset sums of large sets in $\mathbb{Z}/N\mathbb{Z}$ (Erdős Problem 540)

nodes.summary: This is the statement that there is a real number $C > 0$ such that for every integer $N \ge 1$, every set $A \subseteq \mathbb{Z}/N\mathbb{Z}$ with $|A| \ge C\sqrt{N}$ has a nonempty subset $S \subseteq A$ whose elements sum to $0$ in $\mathbb{Z}/N\mathbb{Z}$.
nodes.title: The Erdős–Heilbronn zero subset sum statement (Erdős Problem 540)
